title: Sunday run + abs
subtitle: ~50 min · outside or treadmill · run intervals and a core circuit
feeling: Yesterday was full body weights, so today your muscles get a break from lifting. A run to get your rhythm back, then a solid ab circuit.
note: Keep the run conversational, with the faster minutes at about 7 out of 10. If your legs feel heavy or any pelvic pain shows up, keep the whole thing easy or switch to a brisk walk. That still counts. Every piece you tap off today is a win.

items.name: Brisk walk
items.cue: Easy pace, swing your arms, let your breathing settle in.

items.name: Leg swings + easy hamstring stretch
items.cue: 10 front-to-back swings per leg, holding a wall. Then a gentle hamstring reach, no bouncing. Your hamstring likes a slow start.

sections.label: 2 · Run · about 30 min
sections.instructions: Start the timer on each step and it counts you through. The middle step runs all 6 rounds of faster and easy for you.

items.name: Easy run
items.cue: Slow and relaxed. You should be able to talk in full sentences.

items.name: Pickups
items.cue: Faster means quicker feet and a bit more effort, not a sprint. On the easy minutes, slow right down and let your breath come back.

items.name: Finish easy
items.cue: Back to an easy jog. Relax your shoulders and enjoy it.

sections.label: 3 · Abs circuit · 2 rounds · ~12 min
sections.instructions: Go through the list, then do it all once more. Rest about 15 sec between moves. Tap a move after round 2.

items.name: Dead bug
items.cue: Low back pressed into the mat. Lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, breathe out as you reach.

items.name: Bird dog
items.cue: On hands and knees. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, hold for a breath, switch. Keep your hips level.

items.name: Side plank on your hand
items.cue: Hand right under your shoulder, arm straight. Lift your hips and reach the top arm up. Drop the bottom knee to the mat if needed.

items.name: Reverse crunch
items.cue: Knees bent, curl your hips up off the mat using your lower abs, lower slowly. No swinging.

items.name: Russian twist
items.cue: Lean back a little with a tall chest. Rotate from your ribs, not just your arms. Heels can stay down.

items.name: Toe taps
items.cue: Legs in tabletop, tap one heel down at a time. Keep your low back on the mat.

items.name: Glute bridge
items.cue: Feet flat, push through your heels, squeeze at the top for a second. Feels great after a run.

items.name: Hamstring, hip and calf stretch
items.cue: Hold each stretch about 30 sec per side. Gentle on the hamstring, no forcing it.
